name: Meyer
source: Meyer Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), group column, N'000 scaled to NGN. Net finance income is stored negative; operating expenses are selling, distribution and administrative expenses. | Meyer Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, group column: consolidated statement of profit or loss page 17 and financial summary group page 57. Every populated FY2025 and FY2024 row ties: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, Gross Profit less net operating cost equals Operating Profit, Operating Profit plus Net Finance Costs equals Profit Before Tax, and Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. Operating expenses, operating profit and net finance costs for FY2023 to FY2021 are withheld because the issuer summary prints no operating lines and the stored figures did not tie to the printed profit before tax. | income tax row corrected from the issuer's audited statement so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit | CRON 20261111: Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs added for FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021 from the audited financial statements filed with NGX: Meyer Plc consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 2023 (NGX filing library, 50 pages, audited) and the same statement for the year ended 31 December 2022 (issuer copy, meyerpaints.com annual reports, audited), whose comparative columns print FY2022 and FY2021. Figures are N'000 as printed and stored in absolute NGN. FY2023: revenue 2,266,791, cost of sales 1,377,369, gross profit 889,422, other operating income 13,497, selling and distribution 297,264, administrative 410,202, profit from operating activities 195,453, finance income 159,629, finance costs 4,187, net finance income 155,442, profit before tax 350,895, tax 114,931, profit 235,964. FY2022: cost of sales 1,016,189, gross profit 418,843, operating expenses 568,829 (selling and distribution 227,051 plus administrative 341,778), operating result (98,003), net finance income 80,764. FY2021: cost of sales 725,733, gross profit 392,365, operating expenses 489,284 (177,769 plus 311,515), operating result (22,138), net finance income 82,404. Operating expenses is the sum of the printed selling and distribution and administrative lines, which reproduces the printed operating result once other operating income is added in all three years. Arithmetic checks passed on every period: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, gross profit plus other operating income less operating expenses equals the printed operating result, and operating result plus net finance income equals profit before tax. | CRON 20261111: H1 2026 Net Finance Costs sign corrected to a positive net finance income, matching every annual column in this file; operating profit 276,956 plus 171,887 equals the stored profit before tax 448,843.
